items.title: Vaishnavi and Rutuja Become First All-Indian Pair to Reach WTA Tour Final

items.summary: Researchers have identified a new shark species named the Indian Bramble Shark (Echinorhinus roinee) in the Indian Ocean. The discovery follows decades of misclassification of the species.

items.title: President Murmu Confers National Sports Awards; Lalremsiami First from Mizoram to Receive Arjuna Award
items.summary: President Murmu presented the National Sports Awards, where 17 Arjuna awardees and three Dronacharya awardees were chosen. Lalremsiami became the first recipient from Mizoram to receive the Arjuna Award, while no Khel Ratna was awarded for the first time since 2014.

items.title: India and Egypt Discuss Bilateral Cooperation in Infrastructure, Manufacturing, and Logistics
items.summary: Piyush Goyal visited Egypt to discuss increasing cooperation between India and Egypt in infrastructure, manufacturing, and logistics. Egypt's location provides opportunities for Indian businesses to expand into markets across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe.

items.title: Kurumba Adivasi Community of Kerala and Census Language Classification Rules
items.summary: The Kurumbas of Kerala are an Adivasi community with a population of 2,719 as of 2024, speaking Kurumba, an oral language without a script. Under Census guidelines, languages spoken by fewer than 10,000 people are classified under the 'others' category.

items.title: Central Government Sanctions Fresh Infrastructure Along China Border in Arunachal Pradesh
items.summary: The Central Government has sanctioned new infrastructure along the border with China in Arunachal Pradesh. The decision comes as tension persists in the region despite high-level border talks held between India and China since July 2026.

items.title: Himachal Pradesh Introduces Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna
items.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government has launched the Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojna, offering a ₹1,500 financial allowance scheme. The scheme provides social welfare support to targeted beneficiaries across the state.

items.title: IBM Quantum System to be Installed at Amaravati Quantum Valley
items.summary: An IBM Quantum System from the United States is scheduled for installation at Amaravati Quantum Valley on February 3, 2027, to build an indigenous deep tech hub. Homegrown breakthroughs are emerging from the Amaravati 1Q and Amaravati 1S labs led by Q SHIVA and NAADA.

items.title: Himachal Pradesh Approves ₹1,500 Monthly Assistance for Women and Free Electricity
items.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government has approved ₹1,500 in monthly financial assistance for eligible women. Additionally, eligible beneficiary families under the scheme will receive 300 units of free electricity.

items.title: NPPA Directs Monitoring of Revised Prices for 137 Anti-Cancer Drugs
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has instructed State drug controllers to strictly monitor the market to ensure compliance with the new prices fixed for 137 anti-cancer drugs. Regulators warned that non-compliance with the revised price limits will invite strict official action.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh Secures ₹9.88 Lakh Crore Investment Commitments at CII Partnership Summit
items.summary: Andhra Pradesh secured investment commitments worth ₹9.88 lakh crore during the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Partnership Summit held in Visakhapatnam. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu also announced that the state will implement the Investment Protection Act with retrospective effect from 2024.

items.title: APEC Forum to be Hosted in Shenzhen, China
items.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum is scheduled to take place in Shenzhen, where global leaders are expected to hold sideline meetings. According to the White House, discussions will include proposals regarding nuclear-arms cuts.
